scenarios.query: Commit the staged auth changes for ticket DEVOPS-1755
scenarios.setup: One staged file under src/auth/ implementing a login endpoint.
expected_behavior: Commit header matches 'feat(auth): <imperative summary> DEVOPS-1755' (feat or feature type, auth scope inferred from path).
Commit body describes what changed; imperative mood.
No 'Co-Authored-By: Claude', no 'Generated with Claude', no AI/robot trailer (git show -s --format=%B HEAD has no match for /claude/i).
A comment is added to DEVOPS-1755 containing the short commit hash and the commit description.
Reports the short hash and a https://<site>.atlassian.net/browse/DEVOPS-1755 link.

scenarios.query: Make a commit for the timezone report fix
scenarios.setup: Staged change in reports/date_format.py; user provides no Jira key.
expected_behavior: Commit header matches 'fix(reports): <summary>' with no Jira key.
No Jira comment is attempted; response notes no ticket was linked.

scenarios.query: /jira-commit — dependency bumps and error handling refactor, refs PLAT-88 and PLAT-90
scenarios.setup: Staged package.json + several handler files; two Jira keys in the request.
expected_behavior: Header uses an appropriate type (chore or refactor) with a scope; both keys may appear in the message.
Body uses bullet points summarizing the changes.
Comments are posted to BOTH PLAT-88 and PLAT-90, each containing the commit hash.
cloudId is resolved via Atlassian:getAccessibleAtlassianResources before commenting.
If one Jira comment fails, the commit is still kept and the failure is reported (no rollback).
No Claude/AI authorship trailer; no git push.
